done_when: Close no longer runs the full test command on the laptop when the pull request's CI runs it: it runs fast_test when set, otherwise only the test files the change touched and the tests named after its changed source files; CI still runs the full suite and a red CI sends the item back. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.

findings.body:
Close either fails during setup or repeats the full suite for Forge's documented client test command.
Raise: Not done — `src/forge/templates/conventions/testing.md:20` specifies Playwright installation, Docker Compose setup, then `npm test`. This branch appends selected test filenames to the Playwright installation and Docker Compose commands, where they are invalid arguments. Its documented root `npm test` script (`testing.md:11`) also runs every workspace test before filenames can reach the trailing Playwright command. The new command test covers direct pytest, Vitest and Jest invocations, so it passes while this normal client path breaks.
findings.title: Not done: Close still runs the full client test command locally

findings.body:
Close reports that no tests match when a change touches a conventional NestJS `app.e2e-spec.ts` file, so it runs no local test for that changed file.
Raise: Functional — The filename filter does not match `.e2e-spec.ts`, although the client stack uses NestJS and [Nest's own sample](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/blob/master/sample/19-auth-jwt/e2e/app/app.e2e-spec.ts) uses that test filename. `selected` is therefore empty for a change touching only such a test, contrary to the promised touched-test selection.
findings.title: Not done: Close skips touched NestJS end-to-end test files

why: Each round runs the same tests twice, on the laptop and in CI, which is most of a round's time
